mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (sender_id, sender_role, receiver_id, receiver_role, content, send_time, read_status) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{senderRole}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverRole}, #{content}, #{sendTime}, #{readStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE ((sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{targetId}) OR (sender_id = #{targetId} AND receiver_id = #{userId})) ORDER BY send_time ASC

SELECT cm.* FROM chat_message cm INNER JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS other_id, MAX(send_time) AS max_time FROM chat_message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY other_id ) latest ON ( (cm.sender_id = #{userId} AND cm.receiver_id = latest.other_id) OR (cm.receiver_id = #{userId} AND cm.sender_id = latest.other_id) ) AND cm.send_time = latest.max_time ORDER BY cm.send_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET read_status = 1 WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND receiver_role = #{role} AND read_status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND read_status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE DATE(send_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT DATE(send_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS messageCount FROM chat_message WHERE send_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(send_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT sender_id AS userId, sender_role AS role, COUNT(*) AS messageCount FROM chat_message GROUP BY sender_id, sender_role ORDER BY messageCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE sender_role = 'student'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE sender_role = 'teacher'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(LEAST(sender_id, receiver_id), '-', GREATEST(sender_id, receiver_id))) FROM chat_message
